observation.visible_scene: A large wall-like assembly of clear plastic bins stacked in horizontal rows stands on a light wooden floor against a plain white wall with a brown baseboard. Each row holds balls of one rainbow color, ordered top-to-bottom as gray/black, blue, cyan, green, yellow, orange, red, purple, and pink. A magenta spiral track lies on the floor at the lower left and connects into the bottom pink row. The framing is fixed; the wall, baseboard, floor, and spiral track do not move.
visible_changes: Throughout the 1.6 s the upper rows (gray/black through yellow) look essentially unchanged.

In the lower rows a few individual balls slowly roll/advance horizontally to the right: a red ball in the red row, a purple ball in the purple row, and pink balls in the bottom row appear at progressively rightward columns and in tilted (mid-roll) poses in later frames compared with the first frame.
A colored ball near the orange/red boundary shifts position between frames, indicating continued transport in the lower section.
The spiral track, the bin structure, and the background remain static; no camera motion is evident.
outside_clip_unknowns: The trigger or earlier cause of the ball motion (this segment starts mid-process).
What happens after the last frame (whether balls keep advancing, drop, or exit via the spiral).
The full mechanism of the machine and whether the upper rows move outside this time window.
uncertain_details: Exact row assignment of each moving ball is hard because rows are vertically stacked and close together.
Whether any ball transfers vertically between rows or only rolls horizontally.
Small pixel-level differences between frames may be compression artifacts rather than motion.
Precise speed/direction of the rolling balls.
